title.ko: 항의·공식 서한: I am writing to express · I would appreciate it if · I must insist

explain.ko: 항의 편지는 감정적으로 쓰지 않고 사실, 요구, 기한을 분명히 하는 것이 효과적입니다. 구조는 목적(I am writing to ...), 문제의 설명(날짜·주문번호 등 사실), 요구(I would appreciate it if ... / I must insist on ...), 결과 경고(Should this remain unresolved ...), 마무리(I look forward to ...)입니다. 정중한 표현(would appreciate, should be grateful)으로 분위기를 유지하면서 필요할 때는 insist로 단호함을 보입니다.
explain.en: An effective complaint letter avoids emotion and states facts, demands and deadlines. A typical structure: purpose (I am writing to ...), the problem with facts (dates, order numbers), the request (I would appreciate it if ... / I must insist on ...), a warning of consequences (Should this remain unresolved ...), and a closing (I look forward to ...). Polite phrases (would appreciate, should be grateful) keep the tone civil, while insist signals firmness when needed.

rows: I am writing to complain about …
I would appreciate it if you could refund me.
I must insist on a full refund.
Should this remain unresolved, I will cancel.

notes.en: State facts with exact dates and numbers.
Naming a deadline makes it more effective.
Avoid emotional words and personal attacks.

task.model: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the delay in delivery of my order. Regrettably, it arrived a week later than promised. I would therefore appreciate an explanation and a refund of the delivery charge. I look forward to your prompt response.

model_trans.ko: 저는 주문한 제품의 배송 지연에 대한 불만을 알리고자 이 편지를 씁니다. 유감스럽게도 약속한 날짜보다 일주일 늦게 도착했습니다. 이에 대한 해명과 함께 배송비의 환불을 요구합니다. 신속한 답변을 기대합니다.
model_trans.en: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the delay in delivery of my order. Regrettably, it arrived a week later than promised. I would therefore appreciate an explanation and a refund of the delivery charge. I look forward to your prompt response.
